title: Asana vs ClickUp
description: Asana vs ClickUp for 2026: compare free-plan limits, project views, automations, reporting, admin controls, and listed pricing. Neither is a universal winner; choose based on your workflow and the plan limits you need.

features.name: Free plan team size
features.tool1Detail: Asana's Personal plan is aimed at one or two people. Confirm the current limits on the official pricing page: https://asana.com/pricing
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp lists unlimited free-plan members, with feature and storage limits. Official pricing: https://clickup.com/pricing

features.name: Core project views
features.tool1Detail: Asana lists list, board, and calendar views on Personal. Timeline/Gantt availability depends on the paid plan.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp lists list, board, and calendar views on Free Forever. Some view limits apply on the free plan; verify the current plan matrix.

features.name: Timeline and Gantt planning
features.tool1Detail: Asana's pricing page lists Timeline and Gantt views on Starter and higher plans.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp's view availability table lists Gantt on Free Forever with usage limits and unlimited Gantt charts on paid Unlimited and higher plans. Details: https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/32274881672599-Views-feature-availability-and-limits

features.name: Automation
features.tool1Detail: Asana lists unlimited automations on Starter. Confirm any plan conditions and current terms at https://asana.com/pricing.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp lists plan-specific automation quotas; the pricing page shows 100 executions on Free Forever, 1,000 on Unlimited, and 5,000 per month on Business. Verify current quotas at https://clickup.com/pricing.

features.name: Reporting dashboards
features.tool1: Starter and above; broader portfolio reporting on Advanced+
features.tool1Detail: Asana lists reporting dashboards on Starter and portfolio-level capabilities on Advanced. Check whether the reporting scope matches your team's needs.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp lists unlimited dashboards with advanced cards on Business. Check dashboard limits and included cards for the plan you would buy.

features.name: Goals and portfolio management
features.tool2: Included in Unlimited and higher plans
features.tool1Detail: Asana lists goals and unlimited portfolios on Advanced. Verify plan availability on the official pricing page.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp's pricing page lists Goals and Portfolio Management on Unlimited and higher plans. Confirm details for your workspace before purchase.

features.name: Custom fields
features.tool2: Basic manager on Free; unlimited on Unlimited+
features.tool1Detail: Asana lists custom fields on Starter and above. Check field and reporting needs for your project templates.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp lists a basic custom-field manager on Free Forever and unlimited custom fields on Unlimited. Verify current limits at https://clickup.com/pricing.

features.name: Collaborative documentation
features.tool1Detail: Asana supports project notes and file attachments; evaluate whether that is enough or whether your team needs a separate knowledge base.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp lists Collaborative Docs on Free Forever. Test permissions, document structure, export, and whether it can replace your existing documentation workflow.

features.name: Integrations
features.tool1Detail: Asana lists 100+ free integrations on its project-management pages. Test the exact integrations and actions you rely on.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp lists unlimited integrations on Unlimited and higher plans. Confirm whether any connector or automation has separate usage limits.

features.name: Enterprise identity and governance
features.tool1: SAML SSO and SCIM on Enterprise
features.tool2: SAML SSO, SCIM, audit log and governance on Enterprise
features.tool1Detail: Asana's pricing page lists SAML authentication and user provisioning on Enterprise. Confirm security and compliance requirements directly with the vendor.
features.tool2Detail: ClickUp's pricing page lists SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, audit log, session management, and governance features on Enterprise. Confirm requirements and contract terms directly with the vendor.

features.name: Listed public pricing
features.tool1: Starter $10.99/user/month billed annually; Advanced $24.99 billed annually or $30.49 monthly
features.tool2: Unlimited $7/user/month billed annually or $10 monthly; Business $12 annually or $19 monthly
features.tool1Detail: Prices shown on Asana's official pricing page when checked on 2026-10-09. Plans and promotions can change: https://asana.com/pricing
features.tool2Detail: Prices shown on ClickUp's official pricing page when checked on 2026-10-09. Plans and promotions can change: https://clickup.com/pricing

verdict: Choose by the work your team must complete, not by a generic winner. Asana's listed plan structure makes it worth evaluating when you need a structured project workflow and portfolio capabilities at the appropriate tier. ClickUp is worth evaluating when a broader workspace with collaborative docs and multiple views is attractive, but check the limits attached to each plan. The public pricing pages show different price points and feature packaging; they are not a like-for-like quote. Run the same pilot tasks in both products, verify every required feature in the intended plan, and calculate the full annual cost before deciding.

faqs.question: Is Asana or ClickUp cheaper?
faqs.answer: The official pricing pages checked on 2026-10-09 list Asana Starter at $10.99 per user/month billed annually and Advanced at $24.99 billed annually ($30.49 monthly). ClickUp lists Unlimited at $7 billed annually ($10 monthly) and Business at $12 billed annually ($19 monthly). Compare the specific features, seats, and billing terms you need; verify current pricing before buying. Sources: https://asana.com/pricing and https://clickup.com/pricing

faqs.question: Which free plan is better for a small team?
faqs.answer: Asana Personal is positioned for one or two people and includes core list, board, and calendar views. ClickUp Free Forever lists unlimited members, but it has limits such as storage and some view or automation usage. If the team has more than two people, compare ClickUp's free limits with the paid features you would need in Asana. Source details: https://asana.com/pricing and https://clickup.com/pricing

faqs.question: Do both tools support timelines and dependencies?
faqs.answer: Both products offer project-planning capabilities, but availability and limits vary by plan. Asana lists Timeline/Gantt views on Starter and higher plans. ClickUp lists Gantt views with usage limits on Free Forever and unlimited Gantt charts on paid Unlimited and higher plans. Confirm the current plan matrix and test a real dependency workflow. Sources: https://asana.com/pricing and https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/32274881672599-Views-feature-availability-and-limits

faqs.question: Which is better for portfolio reporting?
faqs.answer: Do not decide from the product name alone. Asana lists goals and portfolios on Advanced and above, while ClickUp lists Goals and Portfolio Management on Unlimited and higher plans. Test whether the portfolio view, roll-up fields, permissions, and reports match the questions your managers need to answer. Verify the exact current plan inclusions with each vendor.

faqs.question: How should a team choose between them?
faqs.answer: Create a pilot with the same project, dependency, recurring task, intake form, report, and guest-permission scenario in both tools. Record setup time, task-update effort, automation behavior, export quality, and the annual cost at your real seat count. Choose the product that passes your must-have requirements with less operational friction.

faqs.question: Where can I verify current features and prices?
faqs.answer: Use the vendors' official pricing pages and plan documentation before purchase: Asana https://asana.com/pricing; ClickUp https://clickup.com/pricing; ClickUp view limits https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/32274881672599-Views-feature-availability-and-limits. This comparison records what those pages listed when checked on 2026-10-09; features and prices can change.
